Number of studies.evidence_source: Drawing on our conception of a conditional threshold hypothesis and empirical evidence for an interaction between intelligence and openness in explaining creative achievement, the current study tests such an interaction.

section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses openness to experience as a conditional characteristic influencing the intelligence-creativity relationship, citing prior research by Jauk et al. (2013) which found openness predicted creative potential above an IQ threshold. The current study aims to test this interaction, specifically how openness moderates the curvilinear relationship between intelligence and creative achievement. It also proposes domain-specific moderation, with aesthetic openness influencing creativity in the arts and intellect influencing creativity in the sciences.
